metadata.title: Fabiano Arthur — Full-stack developer
metadata.description: Fabiano Arthur (Zhyorg) — full-stack developer building multi-agent workflows for Claude Code, web apps and APIs. Projects, stack and contact.

hero.body: I'm <name>Fabiano Arthur</name>. I build multi-agent workflows for Claude Code, web apps and APIs — tested, documented and small enough to understand.

about.title: From the API to the last pixel.
about.p1: I work across the stack: data models, APIs, queues, front-ends and the pipelines that ship them. Lately that includes tooling that lets AI agents do real engineering work without making a mess.
about.p2: I care about small releases, honest tests and docs that answer the next person's question before they ask it.

tested.title: Tested
tested.body: Logic gets unit tests; gates run in CI before anything merges.

documented.title: Documented
documented.body: READMEs in English and Portuguese, with diagrams that show the real flow.

secure.title: Secure by default
secure.body: Secret scanning, pinned dependencies and least-privilege CI.

projects.title: Things I've built.
projects.intro: Open-source projects — each one with its code, tests and, where it makes sense, a live demo.

kitchen.title: claude-code-kitchen
kitchen.description: Run several Claude Code agents in parallel, each on its own task in its own git worktree, each ending in a pull request — while the main session stays free to talk to you.

discordHq.title: claude-code-discord-hq
discordHq.description: A Discord server defined as code, plus hooks that ping you only when an AI coding session needs you. Run your agents from your phone.

controlRoom.title: Agent control room
controlRoom.description: A live dashboard of coding agents working in parallel: queue, status, streaming logs, gates and pull requests — driven by a deterministic, seeded simulation.

algorithms.title: Algorithm visualizer
algorithms.description: Watch sorting and path-finding algorithms step by step, on an editable grid, with speed control and side-by-side comparison.

arcade.title: Canvas arcade
arcade.description: Classic mini-games written from scratch on HTML canvas, with keyboard and touch controls and a local high-score board.

regex.title: Regex playground
regex.description: Write a regular expression, see matches and groups highlighted, and read a plain-language explanation of every part — from a hand-written parser.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Accessible React components on top of color, type and spacing tokens, with light and dark themes and a documentation site with live examples.

parking.title: Parking API
parking.description: A parking-lot API with spots, reservations, check-in/out and time-based pricing rules, standardized errors and OpenAPI docs.

barbershop.title: Barbershop platform
barbershop.description: Multi-location barbershop management: scheduling, services and staff, with a NestJS API and a React front-end.

contact.title: Have something in mind?
contact.body: Questions about a project, a bug report or an idea — email is the fastest way to reach me.
